messages:
sasha: quick thread on PR #5248 -> we're updating the onprem migration guide and the disconnected install appendix. QA hit two issues: 1) KMS/HSM examples show IPs in /etc/hosts which reads as required, 2) an SDK snippet for the node client points to a removed anchor. can we align on canonical wording?
omar: prefer: recommend resolvable FQDNs + TLS certs for production. document /etc/hosts as a last-resort bootstrap for air-gapped sites only. add explicit 'bootstrap only' label.
pri: SDK bit: the node snippet currently links to `#auth` anchor which no longer exists; change to `#credentials-and-auth` and add a tiny example showing ENV var usage rather than inlining API keys. also add a python snippet with requests + custom CA (customers keep asking).
ke: HSM note: include vendor-agnostic PKCS#11 stub and a short note: prefer PIN from env or KMS-proxy, not in config files. also call out that some HSMs have management ports on a separate NIC and need explicit firewall rules.
sasha: can we also add a small IPv6/dualstack note? at some sealed sites people prefer IPv6-only mgmt networks. say: we support IPv6 but examples use IPv4; provide guidance for dualstack and how to adapt nftables rules.
omar: good call. include an example nftables snippet for the outbound egress rule set and a short comment about MTU on tunnels (we saw fragmentation issues).
pri: proposed text for certs: "Cert CN or SAN MUST match the hostname clients use. Prefer hostname-based certs. If using /etc/hosts for bootstrap, include the IP in the cert SAN or prefer hostname-based certs."
ke: here's PKCS11 stub to include in appendix:
```
pkcs11:
  library: /usr/lib/libpkcs11-vendor.so
  token: "hsm-token-01"
  slot: 0  # verify with vendor tool
  pin_env: HSM_PIN  # use env var or KMS-proxy
```
pri: node SDK snippet suggestion (avoid inline key):
```js
// Node example using env VAR and custom CA
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, caPath: '/etc/redwood/ca.pem' });
```
pri: python snippet:
```py
import requests
resp = requests.get('https://kms.example.local/health', verify='/etc/redwood/ca.pem')
```
link-bot: linkcheck: updated anchor references in branch; 2 old anchors replaced.
ci-bot: docs-ci: build succeeded for PR #5248 (:white_check_mark:)
sasha: great, i'll add a short troubleshooting bullet on hairpin/NAT for control-plane probes and a note about MTU fragmentation on encrypted tunnels. will squash and request final review.
omar: LGTM after tiny wording tweaks. thanks all :)
